_comment: The plugin directory names Hermes itself bundles, recorded so a JARVIS plugin
cannot quietly take one. Nothing enforces uniqueness across the two sets at
runtime: Hermes loads its own and JARVIS' from different directories, so a
collision is not an error, it is two plugins answering to one name in a config
and in `hermes plugins list`. `disk-cleanup` is bundled and `disk-space` is
ours, which is how close this already is.
Refreshed by hand from a Hermes install, deliberately: the list is a claim
about a specific Hermes version, and a generator run in CI would silently
re-record whatever the new image happened to carry, which is the notification
Read at push time too — hermes/plugins/jarvis-selfext reserves these names so
a self-extension capability cannot be created with one.
